# THNK

> Techno and progressive DJ and producer from the Netherlands. Releases on
> Armada (including Electronic Elements and Statement!), Coldharbour
> Recordings, Songspire, Phenomena and Orange Recordings.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thomv-flow8.github.io/THNK/): latest release, Spotify player, shows, about and booking.
- [Music](https://thomv-flow8.github.io/THNK/music.html): every EP, single and remix, filterable by year.
- [Contact](https://thomv-flow8.github.io/THNK/contact.html): bookings, remixes and collaborations.
- [Privacy](https://thomv-flow8.github.io/THNK/privacy.html): what this site stores and which third parties load.

## About

THNK makes techno and progressive built on long lines and a tight kick. His
remix of Three Drives - Greece 2000 and the track Rush have drawn well over a
million listeners between them. In 2018 he played the Progressive Stage at
A State Of Trance 850 in Utrecht.

Tracks by THNK have been played by Armin van Buuren, Paul van Dyk, Ferry
Corsten, Richie Hawtin, Markus Schulz, Aly & Fila, Cosmic Gate, Gareth Emery,
Sander van Doorn, Andrew Rayel, SOFI TUKKER, Andy Moor, Judge Jules, Eddie
Halliwell, Ben Gold, Kryder and Max Graham.
